basis: pulse-live-v5-1110, INTERVALS.jsonl and ATTEMPTS.jsonl of 521 complete trials (medians): start 2.8 s, control 18.5 s, admin 22.7 s, benign 19.9 s, attack to the next trial 22.0 s, 85.9 s in all (525 trials in 12.54 h); v6 adds the lotl step (same structure as the admin step, about 22.7 s) and the 3 s pause after the attack when it is not the last step (3 of 4 orders), so about 111 s per trial and 22.7 h for 735 trials (estimate); 1.5 h prefix + 22.7 h leaves about 1.8 h of margin (the first version of this amendment said 106 s and 2.9 h, from the code alone)
